caption: The drawing depicts a flat, stylized figure of a person standing in profile, facing right, placed above a horizontal, fish-like shape. The figure appears to be female, with a crown-like shape on the head and a skirt, and is rendered in shades of brown and muted red, with subtle lines suggesting wood grain texture. Both arms extend forward, with the right arm slightly lower than the left. The figure’s left leg is bent at the knee, while the right leg is straight. The fish underneath the figure is horizontally aligned, colored similarly in muted browns and decorated with a circular mark and simple lines suggesting an eye and gills. A thin vertical rod connects the figure to the fish, visible between the legs and extending below the fish. The background is a plain off-white or cream color with no additional objects or designs, and the entire composition is centered within a rectangular frame that is slightly darker than the surrounding paper.
title: Weather Vane
